Multiplying the matrix by the vector using the usual method, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Ax & =[\begin{aligned}-3+5\text{i} & 4-3\text{i} \\ -4\text{i} & 5-5\text{i}\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}-3\text{i} \\ 4-5\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}(-3+5\text{i})(-3\text{i})+(4-3\text{i})(4-5\text{i}) \\ (-4\text{i})(-3\text{i})+(5-5\text{i})(4-5\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}(15+9\text{i})+(1-32\text{i}) \\ (-12)+(-5-45\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}16-23\text{i} \\ -17-45\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
